decision.interpretation: The finite-volume Hummer proposal now has exact pairwise thermal microreversibility and Bose stimulation. This is the detailed-balance/Fokker-Planck completion, not a substitute for the exact event-level recoil map.

limitations: The square-root completion fixes the thermal affinity of the two-level Hummer proposal but does not evaluate the exact COM recoil kinematics event by event.
The nonlinear Bose test is frequency-isotropic. Harmonic linear blocks are completed, but nonlinear anisotropic stimulation still requires synthesis to a harmonic-exact grid.
The bounded energy ledger uses mode-weighted cell energies; the exact spatial four-force remains an event-level task.
The full bound+continuum COM-KHW amplitude and HYREC native moment projection remain open.
